newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks indices end largely flat.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks indices end largely flat.

text.p: Madrid stocks indices ended largely flat on Tuesday after a volatile session, and in the short-term traders could not rule out a small correction after recent sharp gains.
The general index slipped 0.04 points, 0.01 pct, to 464.12, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares fell 1.57 points, 0.03 pct, to 5,350.17.
"The market's undertone remains strong, although there are a few doubts about the tendency in the short term and the possibility of a correction after recent gains," said one trader.
After a weak start, stocks were boosted by U.S. December CPI data which came in lower-than-expected. However, in afternoon trade stocks were subject to a bout of profit taking.
Telefonica and Repsol accounted for almost 40 percent of turnover. Telefonica ended 15 pesetas higher at 3,290, while Repsol rose 40 pesetas to 5,710.
Electricity companies performed well with Endesa rising 80 pesetas to 10,150, and Sevillana up five pesetas to 1,340.
